name: Heart Attack
source: Welcome to "Heart Attack," the show where ten women battle it out for money or love. Do you have what it takes to compete against the competition? In a contest with so many hotties, who will you fall for?
translation: 欢迎观看《心脏病发作》，该剧讲述了十位女性为了金钱或爱情而展开的斗争。你有能力与竞争对手竞争吗？这么多美女比拼，你会爱上谁呢？
